title: ABACUS STRU parse abort: LATTICE_VECTORS combined with an explicit lattice type
symptom: ABACUS aborts with 'do not use LATTICE_VECTORS along with explicit specification of lattice type' for /home/ghj/gw/regression_test/g0w0_band_abacus_BN_headwing_shrink_soc_libri/merge_test, before the BN headwing/shrink/SOC G0W0 setup can start.
root_cause: The STRU file specifies both explicit LATTICE_VECTORS and an explicit lattice type. The ABACUS STRU reader treats these as mutually exclusive lattice definitions, so parsing stops with an input-contract error rather than a physics problem.
minimal_fix: Edit STRU so exactly one lattice definition remains: either keep the declared lattice type with LATTICE_CONSTANT/LATTICE_PARAMETERS, or give the three LATTICE_VECTORS explicitly and remove the other declaration.
validation: Re-run the same ABACUS case; the message disappears and the run proceeds past STRU reading into the intended BN headwing/shrink/SOC G0W0 setup.
avoid: Do not add a second lattice declaration to silence the message, and do not patch syntax without first deciding which lattice definition is authoritative.
